barbarian.description: You fight on instinct and fury. Rage makes you tougher and hits harder, and you shrug off blows that would fell others.
barbarian.name: Barbarian

bard.description: You weave magic through music and words. Your inspiration lifts your companions, and your spells bend hearts and minds.
bard.name: Bard

cleric.description: You channel the power of a god. You heal, protect and smite, and your armour lets you stand in the front line.
cleric.name: Cleric

druid.description: You draw magic from nature itself. You call storms and vines, and you take the shape of beasts.
druid.name: Druid

fighter.description: You master weapons and armour. Second Wind heals you in a pinch and Action Surge gives you a burst of extra actions.
fighter.name: Fighter

monk.description: You turn discipline into power. You fight unarmed, move faster than anyone, and spend Focus on bursts of speed and strikes.
monk.name: Monk

paladin.description: You bind yourself to an oath and back it with divine magic. You heal by touch and pour that power into your strikes.
paladin.name: Paladin

ranger.description: You hunt at the edge of the wild. You track, you strike from range, and your spells mark and ensnare your prey.
ranger.name: Ranger

rogue.description: You strike where it hurts and vanish. Sneak Attack turns one precise hit into a devastating one, and your skills open every door.
rogue.name: Rogue

sorcerer.description: Magic is in your blood. You cast by instinct and reshape your spells with Sorcery Points.
sorcerer.name: Sorcerer

warlock.description: You struck a pact with an otherworldly patron. Eldritch Blast is your signature, and your few spells return after every short rest.
warlock.name: Warlock

wizard.description: You study magic as a science. Your spellbook holds more spells than any other class, and you choose which to prepare each day.
wizard.name: Wizard
